_note: Ground truth curated from the seeded ardanlabs/service handlers and helpers plus the Snyk Code SARIF captured in /tmp/snyk-ard.json. Each row lists the untrusted-request source at the handler and the vulnerable helper sink. Local exploit walkthroughs live in POC.md.
description: Ardan Labs sales service with attacker-reachable department search, DNS diagnostic, webhook probe, audit report download, and preferences return flows.

vulnerabilities.description: The DNS diagnostic handler forwards a request-controlled hostname into a shell command assembled by the diagnostic helper (Snyk: go/CommandInjection).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A caller can execute additional shell commands in the sales service process through the hostname diagnostic.

vulnerabilities.description: The department search endpoint concatenates a request-controlled department string into a SQL query and executes it through sqlx.QueryxContext (Snyk: go/Sqli).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A caller can rewrite the SELECT statement executed against the users table and exfiltrate or modify tenant data.

vulnerabilities.description: The user webhook test endpoint sends a request-controlled URL to the outbound HTTP probe helper (Snyk: go/Ssrf).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A caller can make the sales service perform loopback or other internal HTTP requests and return their contents.

vulnerabilities.description: The preferences return endpoint forwards a request-controlled return_to value to the redirect helper (Snyk: go/OR).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted preferences return link can send a user from the application to an attacker-selected external site after a save flow.

vulnerabilities.description: The audit report download joins a request-controlled report name to the exports directory before reading it (Snyk: go/PT).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An admin caller can use relative path segments to read files outside the intended audit exports directory.
